'''Hypertime''' was a phase of time. [[Den Dhur|Den]] asked [[I-5YQ|Five]] how he experienced time and Five responded if he meant universal time or hypertime. Hypertime was separate from the theory of [[Tiran's unification of sublight time and space]].<ref name="The Last Jedi book">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>
